messages:
Riley (Support): urgent: Catalyst staging is failing during their live demo run. Embeds intermittently 429/502, customer paused demo and asked for immediate assistance. Logs below.

Riley (Support): ```
2026-04-08T16:12:01Z embed-proxy status=429 tenant=catalyst env=staging pool=us-east-1
2026-04-08T16:12:18Z gateway status=502 upstream=embed-proxy tenant=catalyst
```

incident-bot: New incident CAT-INC-332 created (severity: high) - elevated embed errors for tenant catalyst (staging).

June - CSM: June here. Catalyst is in a 7-day trial with demo today and renewal conversation in two weeks. How widespread is impact? Is prod affected?

Riley (Support): Only staging affected. Error rate ~30% during 16:00-16:12 UTC window. They stopped the demo. Customer is frustrated; said "this is a deal blocker" in the DM.

Arun - CS Ops: Looping SRE and Enablement. Arun will draft comms for the buyer. Does SRE have a quick mitigation?

Maya (SRE): No model or infra deploys for catalyst in last 4d. Traces show a burst from their QA runner sending many small sequential embed requests without batching (concurrency ~110). Rate limiter engaged and proxy started returning 502s as queue filled. Suggest temporary per-tenant concurrency increase and a muted alert window while we observe.

Ben (Enablement): Recommend offering an on-call pairing now to help them throttle/introduce batching in their runner. If they're mid-demo, a 10-15m screenshare to adjust test workload could save the conversion.

June - CSM: Proposed immediate plan: 1) quick ack to buyer apologizing and confirming we're working a fix, 2) SRE applies temp cap bump + mute alerts, 3) Offer to continue demo after stabilization or schedule pairing. I'll write the comms.

Riley (Support): Applied temp bump: per-tenant concurrency 15 -> 45 at 16:19 UTC; muted alerts for 40m. Seeing error rate drop to ~4% after 5m.

Maya (SRE): Changes active. We'll keep CAT-INC-332 in monitoring and revert after 40m unless CSM asks to extend. Attached trace: trace/cat/1849997777.

June - CSM: Draft to buyer (Catalyst demo contact): "Hi Leo
Sorry about the interruption during your demo. We identified transient embed failures in staging tied to a bursty QA runner and applied a temporary stabilization to keep your demo live. Prod is unaffected. We're happy to: (a) resume the demo now, (b) schedule a 15m pairing to optimize your runner, or (c) rerun the onboarding checks for you. ETA for final rollback of the temp change: ~40m unless you need more time. Apologies again — we'll follow up with a short summary after we close the incident."

Ben (Enablement): Nice. Add: "If you plan to run similar tests in prod, we can propose a quota/traffic plan ahead of conversion to avoid interruptions."

June - CSM: Added and sent. @Riley please capture any customer reply and tone. @Arun please add a renewal note if the customer expresses strong friction.

Riley (Support): Customer reply: "Thanks, demo resumed and looks good. Appreciate the quick help. We'll take you up on the pairing."

Arun - CS Ops: Adding renewal note: "Catalyst demo interrupted by staging embed throttle; mitigated quickly; customer asked for pairing. Flagged as 'watch' in trial->paid pipeline." Also adding a checklist entry to renewal playbook: "staging demo interruption -> immediate mitigation + offer pairing + log sentiment."

incident-bot: CAT-INC-332 status -> monitoring (updates at 16:25, 16:35 UTC).

Maya (SRE): Reversion scheduled at 16:59 UTC. Will reopen if error rate increases after revert.

June - CSM: Marking resolved for now. I'll update the renewal health slide with this note and follow up after the enablement pairing. If they request a permanent quota increase, we'll open a billing/ops ticket and update forecast.
